review:caldera-art#1.head: 58295cc4 (code a716d37d); blockout compared: 8082e99a
review:caldera-art#1.summary: Not next to Halyard Marina tonight. The engine side holds: the colliders, nav and lava data are identical to the blockout in all five modes (check-maps 1805 / 1867 / 1674; climb-audit, cover-map, spawn-mid, tower-check and every lava-audit rule byte-identical to 8082e99a, rule 42 now 0 / 1152 thanks to the backdrop), the engine tests pass, both bot matches have 0 lava deaths, the GPU is 0.94x Halyard by method C, draw calls and cpuRender sit under Halyard, team ink stays the loudest colour next to the lava, and nothing new crosses the network. The art does not reach the bar. I ran the sweep myself (day LOW and dusk HIGH, 509 views each) and looked at every page: most eye-level views are still bare grey, cream or brown boxes on cracked paving and flat untextured walls, and 621 of 812 eye-level pieces in Alpha's half carry no dressing at all. Mid, the place the user cares about most, is worse than in the blockout: the Surge Gauge's new copper float well (2.2 m wide) and four pier collars stand on the Pour Floor with no collider, so the tower in Tower Command starts inside a column and players and shots pass through what looks like solid metal, while the Organ Pipes (the lookouts) are still plain grey prisms because their new dressing is built at the world origin instead of on the pipes. On top of that, 22,563 dressing vertices stand in the player's body space on walkable floors with no collider (spawn gallery, Lakefront, Casting Floor, yard, terrace), 24 Halyard harbour lamps are scattered without regard to the lava (four stand in the Slump lava, two on the Tide Boards' tops, two on the cairns' tops), brick boxes float in the air past the rim on the hero card, and the backdrop is flat untextured slate cliffs under a rock overhang, so the day card measures 89 against Halyard's 118.5 (top third 84 against 174). The report also claims things the pictures do not show: the eight before / after pairs are not from the same cameras, and decal-09 and decal-11 show no decal. Fix the mid first (the float well and collars, the Organ Pipes), then the ghosts and lamps, then dress every eye-level piece the sweep lists, then the backdrop.

issues.title: Mid: the Surge Gauge dressing puts a 2.2 m copper column and four pier collars on the Pour Floor with no collider; the tower starts inside it
issues.evidence: arch.js D.caldera_surge_gauge builds a 'copper float-well' cylinder r 1.1 m from y 1.2 to 13.7 at (0, 0) and four pier collars (r 0.55, 1.6 m tall) at radius 2.4 on the diagonals, plus lattice chords from those corners. The play geometry keeps the Pour Floor open (the centre zone, the Pond, the tower's start at [0, 1.8, 0]) and the piers off the diagonals so the Pond is seen from all 8 directions; the only colliders there are the four piers (to 7 m), the two tie girders (6.0-6.9 m) and the hidden gauge works above 7 m. Reviewer probe (headless PropKit build of every placement against the built level): caldera_surge_gauge 698 vertices 0.1-1.6 m over the Pour Floor and > 0.2 m from any solid block, clusters at (+-2, +-2); Tower Command shots: the tower and its mast inside the column, the collars at its corners, the open centre of 8082e99a gone — tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review1/r1-mid-gauge-tower.jpg; same-camera pour-floor / gauge pairs in tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review1/r1-pairs-same-camera-day-low.jpg; decal-09-pourfloor.jpg shows the column instead of the floor mark.
issues.fix: Nothing visual below the hidden gauge-works box (y 7) except inside the four layout piers (x +-3.6..4.8, z +-1.15..2.35) and the tie girders' boxes. Delete the float well's lower 5.8 m (start it at y 7, or hang the float from the works), move the collars onto the real piers, start the lattice chords at the piers' tops. Then re-shoot Tower Command at the start, a Zone Control view of the centre zone and the eight Pond sightlines from 7 m, and show 0 dressing vertices over the Pour Floor's top (the probe below).

issues.title: The Organ Pipes (the lookouts, mid's landmark climb) are still bare grey prisms; their new dressing is built at the world origin
issues.evidence: Every lava:organL / organA / organB view in both sweeps is a flat grey hexagonal column and plain square pipes (day LOW views 452-522, flat-block share up to 0.47; dusk HIGH views 452-522 near-uniform purple, up to 1.00): tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review1/r1-sweep-day-low-p23.jpg, -p25.jpg, r1-sweep-dusk-high-p23.jpg, -p25.jpg, r1-ghosts-lamps-organs.jpg (organ-L-high). Probe: 0 dressing vertices within 10 cm of any of the 48 rider parts. Cause: arch.js registers D.caldera_organ_stump and D.caldera_socket_collar under the same names as props.js (registerArch runs last and overwrites them), and PLACEMENTS place both at pos [0, 0, 0] (mirrored to the same point): the collars (r 1.25 at y 1.6 / 3.2 / 4.8), the five checker-plate step links with yellow grab handles and the bulkhead lamp are built twice round the gauge's float well at the centre (probe: 890 vertices 0.24-1.57 m over the Pour Floor at (+-1, 0), (+-1, +-1)); decal-09 shows the handles there. The step links do not read as climbable on the pipes because they are not on the pipes.
issues.fix: Give the Organ Pipes their look through the lava engine's rider meshes (their material / a rider-attached group that moves with each part: ask the lead for the hook if it does not exist; static props cannot follow a rider): basalt columns with riveted iron bands, the step links as checker plate with grab handles on the climb faces, worn edges, a lamp. Rename arch.js's types (no collision with props.js names), remove the [0, 0, 0] placements, and show each Organ at LOW and HIGH at eye level with the climb readable.

issues.title: Ghost geometry in the player's space and decor lamps placed blind: props stand on walkable floors with no collider
issues.evidence: Probe (every dressing vertex of the turf build vs the built level): 22,563 vertices 0.1-1.6 m over a walkable top and > 0.2 m from every solid block (31,323 within 2 m and > 8.5 cm), in 23 placement types, clusters (Alpha's; the twins mirror): caldera_hall_roof on the spawn gallery at (-21, -66), (-12, -66) 0.7-0.9 m up (the hooks and posts in the spawn view: spawnA in tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review1/r1-ghosts-lamps-organs.jpg); caldera_pipe_manifold in the yard (-11, -48), (-17, -48) and on the gallery (-13, -66); caldera_planter_urn on the gallery (-20, -65), (-13, -65); caldera_yard_cover_dressing (-28, -58), (-28, -61) up to 1.45 m; caldera_ladle_car on the Lakefront (2..3, -25..-27) (ladle-car-on-lakefront); caldera_pour_floor_dressing on the island (+-2..3, +-6) and the gauge deck (-6, 0) (the A-frame ladders); caldera_pattern_doors on the terrace (-21, -35), (-20, -38) (the brown wedge across casting-bed.0.2); caldera_winch_house 0.4 m past its block over the Lakefront (-25, -22); caldera_rim_head_dressing (-18, -37), (-15, -36); caldera_flask_stack (-14, -37); caldera_mould_stack / ladle_stand / pig_bed / floor_drain on the Casting Floor (14, -16), (16, -13), (7, -14) (also below HIGH in the lava's region, 2,442 vertices); caldera_hornito on the Slump (-25, -11), (-26, -4); caldera_slag_pot, gauge_post, spillway_bridge, capstan, casting_stack, firebrick_store, weigh_office. Decor lamps (layout.decor.lamps, Halyard's harbour lamps, no colliders, 24 with the twins): (-22, -10), (-18, -6) and twins (22, 10), (18, 6) stand over the Slump's open lava with no floor under them (foot at y 0: in the lava at HIGH, hovering over it at LOW; lamps-in-slump-lava, and the post in the lava on caldera-day.webp); (12, -14) / (-12, 14) on the Casting Floor that drowns; (-8.5, -23.5) / (8.5, 23.5) on the Tide Boards' tops at 3.4 m (lamp-on-tide-board); (-26, -30) / (26, 30) on the cairns' tops at 5.4 m (lamp-on-cairn-top); (-5, -2) / (5, 2) on the Pour Floor's edge; (8, -10) / (-8, 10) on the ladle gantry. This breaks the brief's hard limit (props within 8.5 cm of a face, nothing on walkable tops, nothing in the lava's region the engine does not know about). No dressing vertex lies inside a rider's column (Pumice stones, Organ parts): that part passes.
issues.fix: Pull every listed prop back to within 8.5 cm of the block it dresses or remove it; nothing free-standing on a walkable floor. Lamps only where a block carries them (the four lamp plinths), never in the lava's region below HIGH + 0.3, never on a roof top; consider foundry lamps (bulkhead / gooseneck) instead of Halyard's harbour lamps. Prove it with a page test in the aquarium-art.js manner over every caldera placement and the decor lamps: 0 vertices > 8.5 cm from a block over a walkable top, 0 in the lava's region below HIGH + 0.3 off a block.

issues.title: The backdrop and the cards: flat untextured cliffs, a rock ceiling, the day card a quarter darker than Halyard's, dusk murky
issues.evidence: Cards (assets/stages/*.webp, mean grey of the whole card / its top third): Halyard day 118.5 / 174.4, Highmark day 89.1 / 83.7; Halyard dusk 91.0 / 133.9, Highmark dusk 51.4 / 57.0 (tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review1/r1-cards-vs-halyard.jpg). The far scenery is flat-shaded slate-blue low-poly cliffs with blocky teeth hanging from an overhang, pale pyramids and white streak lines (tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review1/r1-card-crops.jpg, left): it closes the void (rule 42 passes) but does not read as a crater rim with smoke and fills the card's sky. At eye level the day is bright (same-camera pairs below) but dusk HIGH is a heavy purple murk where the riders and walls go near-uniform (dusk HIGH sweep mean flat-block share 0.34 vs day 0.21; organ views up to 1.00).

issues.evidence: (1) 'All eight before/after pairs ... identical cameras': the before and after halves of pair-spawn, pair-pour-floor, pair-gauge and pair-organ-pipes are different viewpoints, so the +-10 % proves nothing (the lead asked for same camera, time and settings). With the same cameras (8082e99a vs HEAD, shoot.cjs, lava held), the art is not darker: day LOW casting floor 55.5 -> 67.6, pour floor 74.2 -> 79.2, Slump 30.0 -> 42.8, Rim Head 69.6 -> 85.9, gauge 102.3 -> 107.9, Organ Pipes 71.6 -> 87.8, lavafall 86.4 -> 100.0, spawn 140.6 -> 141.4; dusk HIGH -1 % to +27 % (tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review1/r1-pairs-same-camera-day-low.jpg, -dusk-high.jpg). (2) decal-11-stencils.jpg shows a grey cabinet and a flat wall, no stencil; decal-09-pourfloor.jpg shows the float well and the misplaced Organ grab handles, no floor mark; decal-10 is cut off ('EEP CLEA... NG A SURG'). (3) 'Every single viewpoint across all sweep pages now shows authentic foundry materials': see the eye-level issue. (4) 'Fixed missing face normal on winch-house in layout.js' : the layout.js edits are pattern / mural / env / decor only (no collider changed), which is correct, but the wording invites a geometry worry.

review:caldera-art#2.head: f847307e (scratch head 6e026552); compared with review 1 at 58295cc4 and the blockout at 8082e99a, same cameras and probes as review 1
review:caldera-art#2.summary: Better, and two review-1 blockers are really fixed, but not next to Halyard Marina tonight. Fixed and checked with my own runs: mid is clear below 7 m (the Tower Command start looks as open as the blockout), no loose prop stands on a walkable floor or in the lava (0 of 22,563 ghost vertices left), the lamps stand only on the four plinths, the Organ Pipes' bands and handles now ride the moving columns, the Surge Office's black squares are gone, the cards match Halyard's brightness (day 123.4 / top third 183.2 against 118.5 / 174.4; dusk 87.0 / 135.0 against 91.0 / 133.9), and decals 05-10 read. The hard limits all hold again (geometry byte-identical, every audit unchanged from the blockout, the lava tests, the bake in every mode, both matches with 0 lava deaths, perf under Halyard, GPU 0.91x by method C, ink still the loudest colour). What stops it: the new piece skins put a lid exactly level with the walkable top of the yard, terrace, Rim Head, Moorings and the whole spawn gallery, so 1,385 of the 3,695 m2 of paintable floor in Alpha's half z-fight. It shows as stripes and blocky patches in the spawn's first view, across the sweep, and through the team ink. Another 1,070 m2 of inkable wall is hidden under opaque skins, so ink painted there cannot be seen. At eye level the stage is still mostly boxes: textured cubes with a band and a cap stand in for bollards, cairns, outcrops, capstans, hornitos and mould stacks, and the Casting Hall and perimeter facades are flat colour. About 25 prop types were deleted to reach 0 ghosts rather than refitted, among them the pig beds, mould stacks and ladle stand on the Casting Floor, the ladle car, pipe manifolds, pattern doors and urns. The Organ Pipes are still flat grey prisms. The backdrop is a smooth pink cone, sphere puffs and a gradient band, and a flat orange cone face sits right behind the rim wall at eye level. My bare-piece count on review 1's 812-piece basis is 406 (was 621): 382 of these are the ground, ledges and terrain, which carry the stage surfaces and need no props, and 24 are objects (was 78). The builder's 838 / 844 counts every lid as dressing and leaves out everything below 0.3 m, so it does not measure what review 1 asked. The report's 'matched cameras on both sides' is again not true: the before halves are cropped from my review-1 base shots, label and all, and the after halves are other viewpoints.

issues.title: The piece skins z-fight with the walkable floors and hide the ink: stripes across the spawn, yard, terrace, Rim Head and Moorings
issues.evidence: arch.js D.caldera_piece_skins wraps every Alpha block 0.35-5.5 m tall. In its default branch it adds a 0.4 m basalt band w+0.025 x d+0.025 and a 0.04 m cap, both with their tops exactly at the block's top, so the floor blocks (yard, terrace, rim-head, gallery, moorings) get a lid level with their walkable top. Reviewer probe (probe-cover.js: every paintable face in Alpha's half sampled every 0.3 m, a dressing box 8 mm outside it = covered, 8 mm inside it = coplanar): of 3,695 m2 of paintable floor, 1,385 m2 coplanar and 301 m2 covered. That is the spawn gallery 230 / 230 m2, yard 592 / 693, terrace 211 / 215, rim-head 177 / 192 and moorings 86.5 / 91. Of 9,704 m2 of paintable wall, 1,070 m2 lie under opaque skins: terrace parapets 28 / 28, pattern shop 34 / 34, cupola stack 43 / 67, surge office 45 / 165, sand bin, lamp-post rack, flask stacks, valve chests and others at 100 %. In the pictures: stripes and blocky dither on the floor in spawnA (the first view a player gets), coping.0.0, gallery-stair.0.1, rim-head.0.0, moorings.0.0, gallery-side-stair.0.1, coping.3.0, gallery.0.0, pit-ramp.0.x and urn.x.x, in all four sweep sets. With lemon / grape ink splatted the Moorings and terrace ink is striped by the lid, and the parapet's wall ink is gone. The builder's caldera-art.js misses this because its ghost check counts only vertices more than 8 cm above the floor. Pictures: tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review2/r2-zfight-lids.jpg, r2-sweep-day-low-p02.jpg, r2-sweep-day-high-p00.jpg, r2-sweep-dusk-low-p03.jpg.
issues.fix: No dressing face may lie on or within 1 cm of a walkable or paintable top: stop every skin at least 2 cm below the top it dresses (never a lid), or leave floors to the stage surfaces. No opaque skin over a paintable wall either: dress walls with trims, plinths, pilasters and fittings, leaving most of the face visible (the aquarium's 'drawn under the ink' faces are the model), or make the face non-paintable where a skin must cover it, and tell the lead. Add both checks to caldera-art.js (0 m2 coplanar with a paintable face, covered paintable area listed by tag and justified), then re-shoot spawnA and the gallery, yard, terrace, Rim Head and Moorings views with ink in frame.

review:caldera-art#3.summary: Closer, but not next to Halyard Marina tonight. Fixed and checked: the floor lids are gone (probe-cover floorFight 0 and wallFight 0; ink on the spawn gallery, yard, terrace and Moorings now shows clean, with no stripes in any sweep set); mid stays clear; no loose props and no lamps in the lava; the pairs are honestly same-camera this time; the cards match Halyard's brightness (day 113.1 / top third 166.0, dusk 84.3 / 126.7, against 118.5 / 174.4 and 91.0 / 133.9); the Organ steps are bright and proud and read as a climb. The hard limits hold: geometry byte-identical, every audit unchanged from the blockout, lava.js 60/60, the bake applied in all five modes, both matches with 0 lava deaths, perf and GPU (0.95x) under Halyard, ink still the loudest colour. Three things keep it from the bar. (1) The report says the deleted props were put back (pig beds, ladle stand and car, capstan, cast-iron bollards, rock cairns and outcrops, spatter-cone hornitos), but none of those types is placed: PLACEMENTS holds 14 types and none of them. What the sweep shows is caldera_piece_skins' generic band, cylinder or cap round each collider cube. Bollards, capstans, cairns, outcrops, ingot piles, crates and hornitos still read as cubes in all four sets, and the two spatter cones that are placed sit inside their hornito boxes. (2) The skins now cover signs: the Tide Board's datum scale (decal 08) is under a black box, the SPILLWAY plate (10) is under another, and the HIGHMARK plates (05) are cut to a strip. 7 of the builder's 8 decal pictures show no decal at all. (3) About 200 m2 of inkable wall a kid can stand next to is still hidden under opaque skins (terrace parapets, cairns, outcrops, urns, the tide board, the gauge post and its parapet, racks, grates, the vent hood, valve chests, gallery lamps). Ink splatted there cannot be seen. Also, the backdrop is still a smooth cone with low-poly sphere smoke and a gradient band, and the Organ columns are still flat grey prisms between their bands. My bare count is 640 of 812 on review 1's basis, but every one of those is ground, ledge, step or terrain (0 objects bare, as the builder says). The probe counts a skin as dressing, so the bare count no longer measures the bar; the pictures do.

issues.title: The prop types the report says were put back are not placed; the objects at eye level are still cubes with a band
issues.evidence: Report §3: 'All 24 object types restored with detailed, game-accurate 3D assets ... pig beds, ladle stand and car, capstan, bollards as cast iron, cairns and outcrops as rock, hornitos as spatter cones'. src/world/stages/caldera/props.js PLACEMENTS holds 14 types: lava, rails x2, walls, surge_gauge, pour_floor_dressing, hall_roof, cupola_hood, surge_office, rim_head_dressing, yard_cover_dressing, horizon_dressing, piece_skins, winch_house and hornito x2. D.caldera_pig_bed, caldera_ladle_car, caldera_ladle_stand, caldera_capstan, caldera_mooring_bollard, caldera_chain_bollard, caldera_tide_board, caldera_cairn, caldera_mould_stack, caldera_floor_drain, caldera_pipe_manifold, caldera_planter_urn and caldera_pattern_doors are defined in props.js / arch.js but never placed. At eye level each object is its collider cube, rendered with the stage texture, plus piece_skins' generic shell. That shell is a cylinder of radius min(w, d)/2 + 0.02 inscribed in the cube (bollards, capstan, slag pot, urns), a box 3 cm larger with a scoria band (cairns, outcrops), or a box with two plates (vent hood, gauge post, tide board, gallery lamp). The two placed hornito cones (lathe r <= 0.72) sit inside their 1.4 m boxes and do not show. Sweep views in all four sets: mooring-bollard.0.0-1.2, chain-bollard.0.0-1.2, capstan.0.0-0.2, race-bollard.0.0-0.2, slag-pot.0.0-0.2, urn.0.0-2.1 (textured cubes with a strap); cairn.0.0-4.2 and outcrop.0.0-2.2 (dark navy cubes with a pale cap edge, day HIGH flat share up to 0.29); slump-hornito.0.0-1.2 (brown boxes with yellow studs and a white cross); gallery-lamp.0.0-1.2, tide-board.0.0-0.2, vent-hood.0.0-0.2 and gauge-post.0.0-0.2 (black boxes); lamp-post-rack.0.0-0.2, flask-stack.*, moulding-floor.*, casting-bed.* and ingot-pile.* (plain brown or textured boxes); ladle-stand.0.0-3.2 (a textured cube with green corner posts); mould-stack.0.0-0.2 (a white-banded box in the lava). Pictures: tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review3/r3-still-boxes.jpg, r3-sweep-day-high-p13.jpg, -p14.jpg, -p18.jpg, r3-sweep-day-low-p13.jpg, r3-sweep-dusk-low-p19.jpg.
issues.fix: Place the real objects, fitted to the rule: each one within 8.5 cm of its collider, none on a walkable top, none coplanar. Build them to stand proud of the cube and to hide its corners: a cast-iron bollard lathe about 4 cm larger than the box's half-diagonal, or a bollard the box can hide inside. Model rock (a displaced or faceted mesh that envelops the box) for cairns and outcrops, and spatter cones larger than their boxes. Put back pig beds and ingot moulds on the Casting Floor, the ladle on its stand, the ladle car on its rails, the capstan drum with bars, crates with slats and stencils, and flasks with pins and handles. Or, where an object must stay a box, make that box read as one thing (a riveted iron chest, a palleted crate) rather than a stone cube. Show each in the four sweep sets.

issues.title: Inkable wall a kid can stand next to is still hidden under opaque skins (about 206 m2 at 85-100 %)
issues.evidence: probe-cover2 (review 2's probe plus a 'dead' test: a covered sample counts only if the point 5 cm off the face is open air): live covered wall 375 m2, floor 7 m2; 288.8 m2 of the reported coverage is dead (under solid footprints) and is fine, which confirms the floor justification. The wall tags fail the rule 'ink shows wherever a kid can stand': cairn 92 %, terrace-parapet 94 %, outcrop, urn, ingot-rack, drain-grates, vent-hood, valve-chest, gallery-lamp, ingot-stack and pattern-crates 100 %, tide-board 97 %, gauge-post 97 %, gauge-post-parapet 95 %, chain-bin 90 %, chain-bollard 87 %, slump-hornito 85 % (tag table in the reconciliation). In the picture, every paintable side face of the terrace parapet, cairn, outcrop and sand bin is splatted with team ink and none of it shows: only the run-off on the floor. issues.fix: Either keep those faces visible (trims, bands, fittings over at most about a third of a face, the rest the stage surface taking ink), or ask the lead to make the blocks the skin replaces paint: false (the aquarium's rule: every stand-in drawn by the dressing is a hidden, solid, off-limits block with no paint) and say so in the report. Then re-run probe-cover2: live covered wall near 0 on any object a kid stands beside.

issues.title: The backdrop and the Organ columns are still primitives
issues.evidence: Cards and eye-level views: the Bellows Vent is a smooth maroon cone with faint mottling, filling the left of the day card; the smoke is a stack of low-poly opaque white spheres; the crater wall is flat maroon planes with a soft gradient 'strata' band and a pale chip; at eye level (rim west, past the casting hall) the same flat maroon walls close the view (tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review3/r3-cards-backdrop.jpg). The report's 'faceted scoria cinder cone ... 14 stepped rings, radial erosion fluting', 'soft layered steam' and 'basalt gorge rock with talus scree' are not visible at card or eye level. The Organ Pipes: the step plates are now bright galvanised plates with yellow nosings and read as a climb from the island (improved). But the columns between the iron bands are flat, untextured grey (day) or navy (dusk) prisms: lava:organL views 453-504 in day HIGH have flat share 0.39-1.00, and the crown pipes are plain sticks (tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review3/r3-organs.jpg, r3-sweep-day-high-p23.jpg).
issues.fix: Give the cone and the crater wall real surface (vertex-coloured strata and facets, a scoria texture), make the smoke soft (billboards or translucent puffs), and keep the masts and slabs seated. Give the rider look meshes a basalt material (joint lines, colour variation, a lighter cap) so a column reads as stone up close.
